canceled|A previously planned encounter with the patient was canceled. http://www.hl7.org/FHIR/valuesetencounterstate.html

education|An encounter during which the patient receives 
education

illness|Patient/Provider was hospitalized or otherwise too 
sick
medication|An encounter for issue of repeat/ modify prescription

laboratory|The results of observations generated by 
laboratories. Laboratory results are typically generated by laboratories providing analytic services 
in areas such as chemistry, hematology, serology,
histology, cytology, anatomic pathology, microbiology, and/or virology. These observations 
are based on analysis of specimens obtained from the patient and submitted to the laboratory.

social-history|The Social History Observations define the patient’s 
occupational, personal (e.g. lifestyle), social, and 
environmental history and health risk factors, as well as administrative data such as marital status,
religious affiliation. Race and ethnicity can be reported as observations however they should be properly reported in the patient file

unknown|The condition status is unknown. Note that

should be made to provide a meaningful value other
than “unknown”.
cgm_binary|Patient is not on a cgm user

inpatient|An encounter during which the patient is
hospitalized and stays overnight.
entered-in-error|The statement was entered in error and is not valid.

resolved|The subject is no longer experiencing the symptoms
of the condition and there is no perceived risk of the
symptoms returning.
88123-5|Hunger Vital Signs Q2- The food that (I/we) bought just didn't last, and (I/we) didn't have money to get more.

procedure|Observations generated by other procedures. This 
category includes observations resulting from 
interventional and non interventional procedures excluding lab and imaging (e.g. cardiology catheterization, endoscopy, electrodiagnostics, etc.). Procedure results are typically generated by a clinician to provide more granular information about component observations made during a procedure, such as where a gastroenterologist reports the size of a polyp observed during a colonoscopy.

relapse|The subject is re-experiencing the symptoms of the condition after a period of remission or presumed resolution.
planned|An encounter with the patient is planned on the encounter_date which is in the future

remission|The subject is no longer experiencing the symptoms
of the condition, but there is a risk of the symptoms
returning.
symptom|The recorded condition is a symptom
MS|Moderately susceptible. Indicates for microbiology susceptibilities only.

refuted|This condition has been ruled out by diagnostic and
clinical evidence.

virtual|An encounter that takes place where the patient and 
practitioner do not physically meet but use electronic means for contact.

confirmed|There is sufficient diagnostic and/or clinical evidence 
to treat this as a confirmed condition.
59408-5|Oxygen saturation in Arterial blood by Pulse oximetry

laboratory|An encounter for lab visits prior to patient visits the 
practitioner in his/her office, e.g. a G.P. visit.

rescheduled|A previously planned encounter with the patient has

 provided)

imaging|Observations generated by imaging. The scope

finished|An encounter with the patient is complete; there should be additional encounter data
scheduling_error|An error occurred in scheduling the encounter
other|Any other encounter type that is not described by one of the other values.
no_show|Patient did not arrive to scheduled appointment
VS|Very susceptible. Indicates for microbiology susceptibilities only
snomedct|FHIR standard uses snomed ct for describing encounter reason
left_before_finish|Patient arrived and met with a provider but left before appointment was officially completed.

home|An encounter where the practitioner visits the 
patient at his/her home.
complaint|The recorded condition is a complaint

therapy|Observations generated by non-interventional 
treatment protocols (e.g. occupational, physical, radiation, nutritional and medication therapy)

provisional|This is a tentative diagnosis - still a candidate that is 
under consideration.
deleted|An old condition that the subject is no longer experiencing. These could be conditions that were never set to resolved.
patient|the patient is responsible for the current status
left_before_seen|Patient arrived but left without seeing MD/RN/etc.
4th|Other nationally recognized or Internal Health System ID
93030-5|Has lack of transportation kept you from medical appointments, meetings, work, or from getting things needed for daily living

exam|Observations generated by physical exam findings 
including direct observations made by a clinician and use of simple instruments and the result of simple maneuvers performed directly on the patient’s body.

survey|Assessment tool/survey instrument observations
(e.g. Apgar Scores, Montreal Cognitive Assessment
(MoCA))
provider|the provider is responsible for the current status
field|An encounter taking place outside the regular environment for giving care.

outpatient|An encounter during which the patient is not 
hospitalized overnight.

active|The subject is currently experiencing the symptoms 
of the condition.
finding|The recorded condition is a finding
diagnosis|The recorded condition is a diagnosis

vital-signs|Clinical observations measure the body’s basic functions such as such as blood pressure, heart rate,
respiratory rate, height, weight, body mass index,
head circumference, pulse oximetry, temperature,
and body surface area.

ambulatory|An encounter where the patient visits the 
practitioner in his/her office, e.g. a G.P. visit.

daytime|An encounter where the patient needs more 
prolonged treatment or investigations than 
outpatients, but who do not need to stay in the 
hospital overnight.

differential|One of a set of potential (and typically mutually
exclusive) diagnosis asserted to further guide the
diagnostic process and preliminary treatment.
device_report_patient_reviewed|Patient did not review device data
emergency|An encounter in the Emergency Care Department.
First two digits|Data specification: 00 == core, 01 == diabetes
schedule_conflict|patient or provider had a scheduling conflict
